messages:
Maya (docs): Quick sync 3: docs migration guide has multiple examples still using `tool.call` and the older response envelope. CI linkcheck didn't fail the page, but unit-test snippets are red in the SDK PR. Can someone help coordinate a tidy migration?
Arjun (eng): I bumped into this while reviewing #1310. Our runtime now expects `invoke` with an `operation` block rather than `tool.call`. Minimal change on the examples, but we should standardize the sample response shape across JS/Python/Go.
Nora (devex): I can update examples for JS/Python today. Can you post a canonical sample response and the JSON schema fields we should show?
Isaac (eng-ml): Canonical response we landed on in the infra RFC: `{ "status": "ok", "payload": { "id": "xyz", "meta": {} } }` and `error` is optional. Important: `payload` is required for success responses. Also add guardrail: don't rely on field ordering inside `payload`.
Maya (docs): Thanks. I'll use that shape. Proposed JS snippet for the docs: 
```js
const r = await client.invoke({
  operation: { name: 'calendar.create', params: { title: 'Q2 planning' } },
  consistency: 'strong'
});
// r.status === 'ok'
// r.payload -> { id: 'xyz', meta: { created_by: 'team-a' } }
```
Arjun (eng): Small nit: SDK renamed `params` -> `args` last week. Otherwise looks good. Also add a brief note that routing keys are `operation.name`. Ops uses that for sharding.
Nora (devex): I'll switch to `args`. Also will add a Go snippet for parity. Proposed Go example: 
```go
r, _ := client.Invoke(ctx, InvokeRequest{
  Operation: Operation{Name: "calendar.create", Args: map[string]any{"title": "Q2 planning"}},
})
// r.Payload.Id == "xyz"
```
Isaac (eng-ml): On the schema block in the migration guide: change `payload` to required, and indicate `error` is present only when `status` != 'ok'. Add the guardrail text: "Treat `error` as the canonical failure indicator; do not infer failure from absent fields in `payload`."
Maya (docs): Will add that wording. Also CI flagged a broken anchor in the migration guide linking to `#response-envelope`. The actual heading now is "Response envelope & guardrails" so anchor should be `#response-envelope--guardrails` (we use the double-hyphenifier in our site generator).
docs-bot: link-check(https://docs.redwood.ai/migration#response-envelope) -> 404 anchor. Suggest: #response-envelope--guardrails
Arjun (eng): Confirmed the generator uses double hyphens for ampersand headings. Good catch.
Nora (devex): One more thing: our examples previously suggested relying on `payload.meta.timestamp` for ordering. That's flaky for distributed writes. Can we add a sentence advising clients to use the `created_at` returned by the operation or their own sequencing?
Isaac (eng-ml): Agree. Recommend: include `created_at` in `payload.meta` for operations that create resources. Do not rely on `meta.timestamp` ordering across shards.
Maya (docs): OK I'll: update the JS/Python/Go snippets, update the JSON schema block (payload required), add guardrail notes about `error` and ordering, and fix the anchor. I'll open a small follow-up PR and drop the link here for review.
Maya (docs): PR #1315: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1315 - includes snippets and schema fixes. Please review before merge. :sparkles:
Arjun (eng): I'll add a one-line unit test snippet in the JS SDK tests to assert `r.payload.id` exists so future changes break early.
Nora (devex): Running local linkcheck now, will report any other broken anchors.
Isaac (eng-ml): Quick review done, wording tweak: change "do not infer failure from absent fields" -> "do not treat missing payload fields as implicit failure". Slightly clearer.
Maya (docs): Changed and pushed. CI re-run.
docs-bot: PR #1315 3 linkcheck 3 passed.
Arjun (eng): Merged. :shipit:
Maya (docs): Thanks all. I'll start a docs backlog task to sweep other migration pages for residual `tool.call` references and open follow-ups as I find them. Drop any other inconsistencies here and I'll batch them into the audit PR.
Nora (devex): Filing the audit ticket now and tagging the SDK owners. :clipboard:
